method: Batch 49 (pistonorder): the batch 48 piston harness (real moving piston blocks; the tile loop after every entity and before the server copy update, World.updateEntities order) with mobs standing on a moved block (a cow and a zombie on top of a block pushed east, a cow on a block pushed up, a golem on one, a retracting block) and large mobs (a spider, a size 4 slime with its jump timer fixed to 20, an iron golem) pushed east, into a wall, up and into a ceiling; the player stands far away. Row element 9 lists the moving tiles. Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
